_readme: List API prices used to compute the value multiple, in USD per million tokens.
Override or extend this file with --prices FILE. Your file is merged over
these defaults per model, so you only need to state what differs. Adding a
model that ships after this release needs no code change -- add an entry.
Every provider declares an 'accounting' mode, because providers do not count
input tokens the same way. Getting that wrong silently double-charges or
under-charges, so it is data rather than an assumption:
cache_excluded_input  input_tokens is FRESH input only; cache reads and
cache writes are reported separately. Anthropic.
so fresh input is the difference. OpenAI / Codex.
'verified' records whether the numbers were taken from the provider itself.
Unverified rates still price normally -- the flag is surfaced in the payload
so the device can say so rather than implying a precision it does not have.

anthropic.source: Anthropic published model pricing table (bundled claude-api reference)

openai.source: third-party pricing aggregators, August 2026 -- openai.com was unreachable from the build environment, so these are NOT confirmed against the vendor. Replace via --prices once you can check them.

plans._note: Monthly subscription cost in USD. NOT from a vendor price list -- claude.com and the Claude help centre were both unreachable from the build environment, and only 'Max starts from $100/month' could be corroborated. Set --plan-cost-usd to what you actually pay; the payload reports which source was used.
